Resolves #21690

`Neo.grid.header.Toolbar#passSizeToBody` now returns while any item is still its config. Reassigning a Gantt's `taskColumns` at runtime made the center toolbar measure its new `TimeAxisHeader` mid-construction, and `item.vdom.id` threw an unhandled TypeError. The toolbar's post-update pass (`Toolbar.mjs:313`) measures the built header right after, so the columns still take their new width.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e, one spec against `dev`'s and head's `Toolbar.mjs`) → L3 required (an error and a width in the browser). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a runtime `taskColumns` reassignment reports no error | CI-covered: `TaskColumnsReassignNL.spec.mjs`; its `workerErrors` fixture fails on the TypeError |
| AC-2 the task column's header and cells take the new width | CI-covered: the same spec polls header and first cell to 160 px |
| AC-3 an e2e red on `dev`, green at head | Outside CI: Test Evidence below |
| AC-4 grid, gantt, scheduler and timeline specs stay green | CI-covered: `e2e-engine`, `unit`, `components` |

### 🔬 Depth Floor

- **Challenge**:
  1. **Post-construction / pre-DOM window for single dynamic-width columns (`src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs:418-455` + `src/main/DomAccess.mjs:585-614`, non-blocking):** `Neo.typeOf(item) !== 'NeoInstance'` closes the mid-`createItems` config window (and once constructed, `TimeAxisHeader` carries `flex: 'none'` and numeric `width`, so `isMeasuredWidth` is `false`). However, if a caller ever invokes `passSizeToBody()` *after* `super.createItems()` finishes (all items are `NeoInstance`s) but *before* `promiseUpdate()` mounts a newly added `flex`/unsized header's DOM node on Main, `DomAccess#getLayoutRect` returns `{}` (`x: undefined, width: undefined`). When `len === 1`, the `for (i = 1; i < len; i++)` loop does not run, leaving `layoutFinished = true` and `rects[0].width === undefined` (`availableWidth: NaN`) until the `promiseUpdate()` callback fires. Guarding `!rects[0] || rects[0].width === undefined` alongside `layoutFinished` is a clean defensive tightening if dynamic single-column runtime replacement ever calls `passSizeToBody()` synchronously post-construction.
  2. **Test helper & naming hygiene (`test/playwright/e2e/gantt/TaskColumnsReassignNL.spec.mjs:12-16`, non-blocking):** The `*NL.spec.mjs` filename convention normally signals the `neuralLink` Playwright fixture, whereas this spec intentionally drives the App Worker via `page.workers()` so it runs in `e2e-engine` without editing `externalBrainSelection.mjs`; also `inGantt` uses `(0, eval)(\`(${source})\`)(gantt)` where a direct inline `worker.evaluate(() => { ... })` avoids string-eval serialization altogether. Safe as-is (CodeQL `Analyze (javascript)` passed and the spec takes no external input), worth preferring direct `worker.evaluate` callbacks in future specs.
